summary: Coos County lookout house built with Weyerhaeuser help in 1948-1953 and abandoned in 1962; the FFLA list says gone and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Lookout house with a cupola (1953 entry); firelookout.com calls it a cabin
facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source we read describes what remains
facts.agency: Coos County FPA (Coos Forest Protective Association); firelookout.com lists Weyerhaeuser Corp.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com lists Weyerhauser Corp.; the Forest Lookouts page files the site under the Coos County FPA. The 1948 and 1949 items show the company and the association both had roles, so the record lists the association and notes the company.

A 1948 report describes a moved building, a 1949 plan says the company would build a tower, and a 1953 entry describes a house with a cupola the company constructed. The sources do not reconcile these.

notes_for_editor: Most dated facts come from one compiled page (Forest Lookouts), which quotes a 1948 Coos Bay Times item, an August 1948 Forest Log item, a 1948 Oregon Department of Forestry report and a 1949 Coos Bay Times item. Those originals were not fetched directly; the quotes are from the compiled page. Elevation 1,698 ft (about 518 m) is not in facts; the record's elevation_m is null and could take it. The record's agency was null; the proposed agency fact is the association with the company named in the conflict note. The 1948 second site at Kelly Butte is not covered. The 'gone' status comes only from the FFLA list; no source describes removal. No photos found with a URL.
